line_items.reasoning: No specific capex actuals were reported in Q3 results to compare against the raised $235M–$255M full-year guidance range, so there is insufficient information to determine a beat or miss.

Q3 gross margin declined 100 bps YoY to 44.9%, falling short of guidance that margins would be roughly in line with Q2 seasonality or slightly better, pressured by mix, import duties, a non-recurring prior-year rebate, and lower supplier rebates.

Digital footprint came in at 61.1% of sales in Q3 2024, below even the already-lowered full-year target of ~63%, indicating the downward revision was still not conservative enough given continued weakness in customer spending volumes.

No quantitative revenue target was provided in prior guidance, so with daily sales rate growth of 1.9% in a persistently weak macro environment, results are treated as inline against the vague expectation of H2 benefit from H1 signings activity.
